newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KEDO buys Oct fuel oil at $123.25-$126/T in tender.
newsitem.headline: KEDO buys Oct fuel oil at $123.25-$126/T in tender.

text.p: The Korean Peninsular Energy Development Organisation (KEDO) has awarded its tender to buy October heavy residual fuel oil at $123.25-$126 per tonne, traders said on Friday.

They said KEDO awarded two 20,000 tonnes cargoes of two percent sulphur grade heavy residual fuel oil to Dutch trader Vitol at $126 per tonne free-on-board (FOB) Okinawa for October 6-10 and October 16-20 liftings.
Two more 20,000 tonnes cargoes for loading during October 13-17 and October 23-27 liftings were awarded to Japan's Mitsubishi Corp at $123.25 per tonne fob Okinawa.
KEDO is an international organisation established to implement a nuclear non-proliferation pact with North Korea and has agreed to supply the country with 500,000 tonnes of fuel oil annually.
